content.short: Bears Club is a play-to-earn game project, one that aims to deliver a fun and interesting club simulation game.
content.description:
Bears Club is a club simulation game project where it will have 10,000 unique and randomly generated Bears as non-fungible tokens, each will have a set of hand-drawn and digitally painted traits, all of those NFTs will have grand importance in all future stages of the project.

The game will have all characteristics of a play-to-earn game monetary-wise, still maintaining quality and all fun as social aspects of it.

Gameplay-wise the club simulation genre follows the same path of other simulation genres, like agriculture simulation genre found in for example Plants vs Undead, Farmville, Wanaka, etc.
